title: people-ops
text:
people-ops

jenna (People Ops): FYI — Priya submitted resignation at 10:12am. Last day is 2026-04-10. Need to coordinate equipment return, benefits/COBRA timing, final pay, and access removal.

sam (IT): Got it. Can someone confirm what device(s) she has and whether she can ship? We need to schedule a secure wipe + SSO deprovision window after last day. :lock:

maria (Hiring Manager): She's remote (SF). Company MacBook Pro 16" (asset 4782) and a YubiKey. Priya said she can ship back — will drop at UPS.

priya (Engineering): I can ship the laptop on Tuesday 4/7 and will include the YubiKey. What's the address and label?

jenna (People Ops): Thanks — please use prepaid label. Ship to: Redwood HQ Returns, 123 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105. I can generate the return label and email it today. :package:

sam (IT): Once you confirm tracking, IT will schedule the wipe for 2026-04-11 09:00 PT. We'll remove SSO and VPN access immediately after wipe, and rotate any shared secrets Priya had access to.

mark (Facilities): Badge access will be disabled 2026-04-11 09:00 PT as well. If she has any physical keys, please include them in the return box or drop at our SF office mailroom.

olivia (Finance): Payroll note — final paycheck will be in the 4/15 payroll run. We'll include accrued but unused PTO per policy. COBRA: benefits will remain active through 2026-04-30; COBRA election packet will be emailed within 14 days of termination. Priya, let me know if you prefer paper or email.

priya (Engineering): Email works. Also, will I get a separate note about stock vesting/RSU treatment?

jenna (People Ops): Yes — I'll send the post-termination benefits + equity summary today. Equity vesting questions referred to People Ops + Legal.

maria (Hiring Manager): Knowledge transfer — Priya is doing a short doc and a 30-min handoff with Lina (backup) on 4/8. PRs assigned in the handoff doc.

sam (IT): Checklist for our side: confirm return label, receive laptop, verify asset tag, wipe, remove from MDM, disable SSO, revoke OAuth tokens, rotate any service account keys noted in the handoff doc. Will post updates here with tracking number.

jenna (People Ops): I'll run the exit interview scheduling — prefer 4/12 or 4/13? Priya, what works? :calendar:

priya (Engineering): 4/12 after 2pm PT works for me.

offboard-bot: Reminder created — offboarding workflow for user priya started (ticket #OFF-4321).

jenna (People Ops): Great. Action owners: People Ops — finalize COBRA + equity note (jenna). IT — secure wipe & deprovision (sam). Facilities — badge/key collection (mark). Finance — final payroll/benefits confirmation (olivia). Hiring — knowledge transfer (maria). I'll update ticket #OFF-4321 as items complete. :white_check_mark:

sam (IT): Shipping tracking: UPS 1Z999AA10123456784 (to be confirmed when label used). Will follow up when the device is scanned in.
